endpoints.basis: Independent opening pitch profiles distinguish the quiet G1/G2 pickup near 0.25 s, C2/C3 near 0.6 s, E-flat2/E-flat3 near 0.95 s, then G2/G3 near 1.25 s. The rejected broad-window endpoint 1.18 s selected the later G and compressed the pickup to 0.026 s. The narrow first window is a disclosed fitting constraint, not an independent or aural annotation.

provenance: Original CC0 orchestral MusicXML retained byte-for-byte; separately licensed analytical lyric nodes omitted before conversion.
Custom MIDI bypasses articulate playback; source transpositions, including double bass and C horns, remain active. No register-derived part splitting.
Repeat order is a candidate to be inspected against audio harmonic/recurrence diagnostics; duration is not independent evidence of repetition.

bars.description: Quarter-note pickup, then scherzo and trio with its written repeat: first pass through first ending, repeat starts on the trio upbeat within bar140, then second ending and written-out quiet scherzo return. XML1 is the initial pickup; XML141/142 form one 2+1-quarter bar, with only continuation142 marked implicit. The two-quarter first ending XML162 is preserved without importer padding, and P1's explicit endings are shared across identically repeated parts.
